description: This PHP source file defines the 'ProjectServiceException' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Time\Exception' namespace. The class extends the built-in Exception class and provides specific static methods to generate exception instances related to project activity errors in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ProjectServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling project service related errors within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: projectActivityExist
methods.description: Returns an exception signaling that project activities with logged time cannot be deleted.

methods.name: duplicateProjectActivityNameFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating a duplicate project activity name was found.

methods.name: projectActivityNotFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that a project activity could not be located.
